question:
List each patient's ID and blood glucose (GLU) index that were within normal range for patient's whose data was first recorded in 1991.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: blood glucose (GLU) index that were within normal range refers to GLU < 180; data that was first recorded in 1991 refers to year(Description) = 1991;
